Garlic Aioli
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




5 garlic cloves
1 egg, at room temperature
1 cup olive oil, at room temp
1 tablespoon lemon juice

Preparation

1 Crush the garlic in a food blender. Add the egg, and blend for 15 seconds. 2 Very slowly add the oil through the top of the blender so that an emulsion can take place. Stir in the lemon juice by hand.

About


To get the smell of garlic off your hands, simply rub your hands in used coffee grinds. End of odor. In Italy, it is common to eat a whole coffee bean after a big meal so that your lover will not be bothered by garlic.

Comments:
Curt

For a more flavorful, less harsh taste use roasted garlic.
